e.title: Saúde em Dado：把巴西 SUS 微观数据重做成免注册 REST API、Parquet 与 MCP 服务
e.title_en: Saúde em Dado: republishing Brazilian SUS microdata as a registration-free REST API, Parquet downloads and an MCP server
e.title_hk: Saúde em Dado：把巴西 SUS 微觀數據重做成免註冊 REST API、Parquet 與 MCP 服務
e.summary: 把巴西统一医疗系统（SUS）的微观数据重做成开放基础设施：覆盖死亡率、登革热、住院与出生等指标并按市镇拆分，提供免注册 REST API、Parquet 下载与一个可用 AI 查询的 MCP 服务；仓库自述代码为 MIT、原始数据属公有领域，并附方法学页面与 Zenodo DOI
e.summary_en: Rebuilding Brazilian unified health system (SUS) microdata into open infrastructure: mortality, dengue, hospitalisations and births broken down by municipality, with a registration-free REST API, Parquet downloads and an MCP server for AI querying; the repository states its code is MIT with original data in the public domain, and ships a methodology page and a Zenodo DOI
e.body:
**saude-publica-br（项目名「Saúde em Dado」）** 是一个**把巴西统一医疗系统（SUS）微观数据重做成开放基础设施**的项目（仓库 `pedropaulofernandes88-stack/saude-publica-br`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 60,178 KB、创建于 2026-06-10、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 其许可在 GitHub API 侧实测为 `NOASSERTION`（非标准 SPDX）**——**但 README 徽章逐字为 `MIT`，且正文说明「原始数据属公有领域」**（**详见下方标注第 ① 条**）。**其 topics 逐字实测达 20 项**：**brazil、data-engineering、datasus、dbt、dengue、duckdb、epidemiology、health-data、mcp、model-context-protocol、mortality、nextjs、open-data、open-science、postgrest、public-health、python、saude-publica、supabase、sus**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：**README 实测 14,920 字节**，**项目自称逐字（葡萄牙语）**：**「Inteligência epidemiológica aberta sobre os microdados do SUS」**——**「关于 SUS 微观数据的开放流行病学情报」**；⭐ **其覆盖范围逐字为一句话**：**「Mortalidade · Dengue · Internações · Natalidade · Vulnerabilidade social — do Brasil inteiro, a custo zero.」**——**死亡率 · 登革热 · 住院 · 出生 · 社会脆弱性，覆盖全巴西、零成本**。**徽章与入口逐字实测**：**许可徽章 `licença MIT`**；**成本徽章 `R$ 0/mês`（每月 0 雷亚尔）**；⭐ **数据来源徽章 `DataSUS: SIM·SINAN·SIH·SINASC`**——**即其数据来自 SUS 的四个具体信息系统：SIM（死亡）、SINAN（法定传染病，登革热在此）、SIH（住院）、SINASC（出生）**；**版本徽章 `v3.3.0`**；⭐ **DOI 徽章指向 `10.5281/zenodo.20706845`**；**站点入口逐字为 Site／API（`saudeemdado.com/dados/`）／Análises／⭐ Metodologia**。⭐ **仓库描述逐字（葡萄牙语）另说明**：**「…API REST sem cadastro, downloads em Parquet e servidor MCP para consulta por IA. Infraestrutura a custo zero」**——**免注册的 REST API、Parquet 格式下载、以及**供 AI 查询用的 MCP 服务**，零成本基础设施**。⭐ **涉及许可的关键句逐字**：**「licença MIT. Dados originais em domínio público (DATASUS/MS, IBGE, IPEA…)」**——**代码许可是 MIT，**原始数据属公有领域**（来源为 DATASUS／卫生部、IBGE、IPEA 等）**。⭐⭐ **另经探活实测三项**：**方法学页面 `https://saudeemdado.com/metodologia/` 实测 HTTP 200、232.8KB、标题逐字「Metodologia · Saúde em Dado」**；**其 Zenodo DOI 实测可解析**：**`https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20706845` 实测 HTTP 200、85.8KB、标题逐字「Saúde em Dado: inteligência epidemiológica aberta sobre os microdados do SUS | Zenodo」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「把政府微观数据重做成 API + Parquet + MCP」是本条目最有价值的形态，也是本站此前没有的一层**——**开放数据常见的终点是「下载一个很大的压缩包」**，**而这个项目把它推进到**可直接查询（REST）、可直接分析（Parquet 列式）、可被 AI 调用（MCP）****；**对做数据工程或需要真实公共卫生/死亡率数据的学生，这是一条**从「政府原始数据」到「可用基础设施」的完整路径样本****（**可与池内 [[apra-mcp]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]]、[[cms-beneficiary-fhir]] 并读——**那几条是澳洲审慎监管局、美国医疗价格透明与联邦医保的开放数据入口，本条目补的是**巴西 SUS 侧**，且形态上包含 MCP**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「代码 MIT、原始数据公有领域」这一区分值得单独记一笔**——**它解释了为什么 GitHub API 报 `NOASSERTION` 而 README 徽章报 MIT：**一个仓库里同时存在**自有代码**与**他人的公有领域数据**，两部分的授权条件不同****；**这与第 317 轮 [[bank-in-domains]] 的许可来源冲突是同一类现象，但**本项目的冲突有 README 明确解释**，**故本词条如实并列记录，而**不**像第 317 轮那样只能说「两者不一致、请自行核对」**（**⚠️ 本次未打开仓库内 LICENSE 文件逐字核对**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「方法学（Metodologia）页面单设且实测 232.8KB」是一件重要的事**——**把政府微观数据做成指标，必然包含**大量口径选择**（分母、年龄标准化、市镇归属、缺失处理）**，**而该项目把方法学单独成页**；**对要引用其指标的学生，这是必须读的一页**（**⚠️ 本次未打开该页内容，故不转述其口径**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 数据来源徽章直接点名四个 SUS 信息系统（SIM／SINAN／SIH／SINASC）**——**这比笼统说「来自 DataSUS」有用得多**，**因为四个系统的**用途与质量特性各不相同****；**对做流行病学或健康险数据的学生，「哪一个系统」决定了字段与偏倚**（**本次未核实各系统的具体抽取方式**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 技术栈实测为 dbt ＋ DuckDB ＋ Supabase ＋ PostgREST ＋ Next.js**——**这是一套**低成本开放数据栈****：**dbt 做转换、DuckDB 做列式分析、Supabase/PostgREST 暴露 REST、Parquet 供下载**；**「每月 0 雷亚尔」的成本主张正来自这套选型**（**⚠️ 本次未核实其成本主张的实际依据或可持续性**）。**⑥ ⭐ 「免注册」值得注意**——**很多开放数据门户要求注册或申请**，**而「sem cadastro」把使用门槛降到零**（**⚠️ 本次未实际调用其 API 验证**）。**⑦ ⭐ 该项目另有 Zenodo DOI，**说明它也被当作可引用的成果发布****——**与同轮 [[rki-excess-mortality]] 一样，**「有 DOI」正在成为开放数据项目的常见做法****（**可与池内 [[openfisca]]、[[worldbank-data]]、[[fred]]、[[cms-open-data]] 并读——**那些是政策微模拟与主流开放数据入口，本条目补的是**中等收入国家的公共卫生数据基础设施****）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可来源冲突（已获解释，仍须并列记录）**：**GitHub API 实测返回 `NOASSERTION`**，**而 README 徽章为 `MIT` 且正文说明原始数据属公有领域**——**本词条并列记录，并提示：使用其代码与数据前应自行核对仓库内 LICENSE 文件与各数据源的授权条款**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该项目的代码确为 MIT，也不主张其数据可无条件商用**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics 20 项、仓库描述、README 的开头区块（自称、覆盖范围、六项徽章、四个入口）与许可句逐字，以及方法学页面与 Zenodo DOI 的可解析性**，⭐ **但**未打开 README 其余部分、未打开方法学页面正文、未调用其 API、未下载 Parquet、未使用其 MCP 服务、未查看任何指标数值****，因此**不能转述其指标定义、口径、覆盖时间范围、市镇层级、更新频率、数据量或方法论细节**；**③ ⭐⭐ 「免注册 REST API」「Parquet 下载」「MCP 服务」三项均**未实际测试****，**故本词条**不主张**其当前可用或稳定**；**④ ⭐ 覆盖范围「死亡率、登革热、住院、出生、社会脆弱性」来自**其自述**，**本次未核对数据**；**⑤ ⭐ 「每月 0 雷亚尔」为**自述的成本主张**，**其可持续性、是否依赖免费额度或赞助本次未核实**；**⑥ ⭐ 该项目为个人账号下的项目（★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-06-10）**，**不主张机构背书、长期维护承诺或稳定性**；**⑦ ⭐ 涉及**巴西公共卫生微观数据**——**其是否含可识别个人、如何处理隐私与合规本次未评估**；**本词条**不主张**其数据可无条件再分发**；**⑧ ⭐ 本词条**不主张**该项目的指标可用于任何医疗、保险定价或政策结论**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 与站点实测为葡萄牙语**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/pedropaulofernandes88-stack/saude-publica-br` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 14,920 字节，开头区块与许可句逐字核对）；`https://saudeemdado.com/metodologia/` 与 `https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20706845` 经 `discovery/probe-urls.sh` HTTP 200 实测（232.8KB／85.8KB）；**未调用 API、未下载数据、未打开方法学页面正文、未使用其 MCP 服务**。

e.summary_hk: 把巴西統一醫療系統（SUS）的微觀數據重做成開放基礎設施：覆蓋死亡率、登革熱、住院與出生等指標並按市鎮拆分，提供免註冊 REST API、Parquet 下載與一個可用 AI 查詢的 MCP 服務；倉庫自述代碼為 MIT、原始數據屬公有領域，並附方法學頁面與 Zenodo DOI
e.body_en:
**saude-publica-br (project name "Saúde em Dado")** is a project that **rebuilds Brazilian unified health system (SUS) microdata into open infrastructure** (repository `pedropaulofernandes88-stack/saude-publica-br`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 60,178 KB repository, created 2026-06-10 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ its licence measurably reads `NOASSERTION` on the GitHub API side** — **but the README badge reads `MIT` verbatim and its text states the original data is in the public domain** (**see note ① below**). **Its 20 topics were read verbatim**: **brazil, data-engineering, datasus, dbt, dengue, duckdb, epidemiology, health-data, mcp, model-context-protocol, mortality, nextjs, open-data, open-science, postgrest, public-health, python, saude-publica, supabase and sus**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): **the README measures 14,920 bytes** and the project **describes itself verbatim in Portuguese** as **"Inteligência epidemiológica aberta sobre os microdados do SUS"** — **open epidemiological intelligence over SUS microdata**; ⭐ **its coverage reads verbatim in one line**: **"Mortalidade · Dengue · Internações · Natalidade · Vulnerabilidade social — do Brasil inteiro, a custo zero."** — **mortality, dengue, hospitalisations, births and social vulnerability, for all of Brazil, at zero cost**. **Badges and entry points read verbatim**: the **licence badge `licença MIT`**; a **cost badge `R$ 0/mês`**; ⭐ a **data-source badge `DataSUS: SIM·SINAN·SIH·SINASC`** — **i.e. its data comes from four specific SUS information systems: SIM (deaths), SINAN (notifiable diseases, where dengue sits), SIH (hospitalisations) and SINASC (births)**; a **version badge `v3.3.0`**; ⭐ a **DOI badge pointing to `10.5281/zenodo.20706845`**; and **entry points Site / API (`saudeemdado.com/dados/`) / Análises / ⭐ Metodologia**. ⭐ **The repository description, verbatim in Portuguese, adds**: **"…API REST sem cadastro, downloads em Parquet e servidor MCP para consulta por IA. Infraestrutura a custo zero"** — **a registration-free REST API, Parquet downloads and an MCP server for AI querying, zero-cost infrastructure**. ⭐ **The key sentence on licensing, verbatim**: **"licença MIT. Dados originais em domínio público (DATASUS/MS, IBGE, IPEA…)"** — **the code licence is MIT and the original data is in the public domain, sourced from DATASUS/the Ministry of Health, IBGE and IPEA**. ⭐⭐ **Three further items were probed and measured**: the **methodology page `https://saudeemdado.com/metodologia/` measured HTTP 200, 232.8KB, title verbatim "Metodologia · Saúde em Dado"**; and **its Zenodo DOI measurably resolves**: **`https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20706845` measured HTTP 200, 85.8KB, title verbatim "Saúde em Dado: inteligência epidemiológica aberta sobre os microdados do SUS | Zenodo"**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Rebuilding government microdata into an API plus Parquet plus MCP is the entry’s most valuable form, and a layer this site has not had** — **the usual endpoint of open data is "download a large archive"**, **whereas this project takes it to directly queryable (REST), directly analysable (columnar Parquet) and callable by AI (MCP)**; **for students doing data engineering or needing real public health and mortality data, a complete sample of the path from raw government data to usable infrastructure** (**readable with [[apra-mcp]], [[healthcare-mrf-api]] and [[cms-beneficiary-fhir]] — those are Australia’s prudential regulator, US healthcare price transparency and federal Medicare open data entry points, whereas this adds the Brazilian SUS side and includes an MCP**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The distinction "code MIT, original data public domain" deserves separate note** — **it explains why the GitHub API reports `NOASSERTION` while the README badge reports MIT: one repository contains both its own code and someone else’s public-domain data, and the two carry different terms**; **this is the same class of phenomenon as round 317’s [[bank-in-domains]] licence conflict, but here the README explains the conflict explicitly**, **so the entry records both side by side rather than only saying "they disagree, check it yourself"** (**⚠️ the LICENSE file inside the repository was not read verbatim**). **③ ⭐⭐ That a methodology page exists separately and measurably measures 232.8KB is important** — **turning government microdata into indicators necessarily involves many definitional choices (denominators, age standardisation, municipal attribution, missing-data handling)**, **and the project gives methodology its own page**; **for anyone citing its indicators, this is the page that must be read** (**⚠️ that page’s content was not opened, so its definitions are not restated**). **④ ⭐⭐ The data-source badge names four SUS systems directly (SIM/SINAN/SIH/SINASC)** — **far more useful than saying "from DataSUS" generically**, **because the four systems differ in purpose and data quality**; **for students of epidemiology or health insurance data, which system determines the fields and the biases** (**how each system is extracted was not verified**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ The measured stack is dbt plus DuckDB plus Supabase plus PostgREST plus Next.js** — **a low-cost open data stack**: **dbt for transformation, DuckDB for columnar analysis, Supabase/PostgREST to expose REST, and Parquet for download**; **the "R$ 0 per month" cost claim follows from that choice** (**⚠️ the basis and sustainability of the cost claim were not verified**). **⑥ ⭐ "Registration-free" matters** — **many open data portals require registration or application**, **whereas "sem cadastro" drops the barrier to zero** (**⚠️ its API was not actually called to verify**). **⑦ ⭐ The project also carries a Zenodo DOI, so it is treated as a citable output** — **as with [[rki-excess-mortality]] in the same round, carrying a DOI is becoming common practice for open data projects** (**readable with [[openfisca]], [[worldbank-data]], [[fred]] and [[cms-open-data]] — those are policy microsimulation and mainstream open data entry points, whereas this adds middle-income-country public health data infrastructure**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence source conflict (now explained, still recorded side by side)**: **the GitHub API measurably returns `NOASSERTION`**, **while the README badge reads `MIT` and the text states the original data is public domain** — **recorded side by side, with the advice to check the repository’s LICENSE file and each data source’s terms before use** (**the entry does not claim the code is definitely MIT, nor that the data is unconditionally usable commercially**); **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, 20 topics, the repository description, the README’s opening block (self-description, coverage, six badges, four entry points) and licensing sentence verbatim, plus the resolvability of the methodology page and the Zenodo DOI**, ⭐ **but did not read the rest of the README, open the methodology page body, call its API, download any Parquet, use its MCP server, or view any indicator value**, so **its indicator definitions, definitions, coverage period, municipal level, update frequency, data volume and methodological detail cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐ The registration-free REST API, Parquet downloads and MCP server were not actually tested**, **so the entry does not claim they are currently available or stable**; **④ ⭐ The coverage list comes from its own description**, **not checked against the data**; **⑤ ⭐ "R$ 0 per month" is a self-reported cost claim**, **whose sustainability and dependence on free tiers or sponsorship were not verified**; **⑥ ⭐ It is a project under a personal account (★0, 0 forks, created 2026-06-10)**, **so no institutional backing, long-term maintenance commitment or stability is claimed**; **⑦ ⭐ It concerns Brazilian public health microdata** — **whether it contains identifiable individuals, and how privacy and compliance are handled, were not assessed**; **the entry does not claim its data can be redistributed unconditionally**; **⑧ ⭐ The entry does not claim its indicators are usable for any medical, insurance pricing or policy conclusion**; **⑨ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README and site measurably are in Portuguese**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/pedropaulofernandes88-stack/saude-publica-br` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 14,920-byte README with the opening block and licensing sentence checked verbatim); `https://saudeemdado.com/metodologia/` and `https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20706845` were probed at HTTP 200 (232.8KB / 85.8KB); **no API call made, no data downloaded, methodology body not opened, MCP server not used**.

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：**README 實測 14,920 位元組**，**自稱逐字（葡萄牙語）**：**「Inteligência epidemiológica aberta sobre os microdados do SUS」**；⭐ **覆蓋範圍逐字為一句話**：**「Mortalidade · Dengue · Internações · Natalidade · Vulnerabilidade social — do Brasil inteiro, a custo zero.」**——**死亡率 · 登革熱 · 住院 · 出生 · 社會脆弱性，覆蓋全巴西、零成本**。**徽章與入口逐字實測**：**`licença MIT`／`R$ 0/mês`／⭐`DataSUS: SIM·SINAN·SIH·SINASC`（即 SIM 死亡／SINAN 法定傳染病／SIH 住院／SINASC 出生四個 SUS 資訊系統）／`v3.3.0`／⭐DOI `10.5281/zenodo.20706845`**；**入口逐字 Site／API（`saudeemdado.com/dados/`）／Análises／⭐Metodologia**。⭐ **倉庫描述逐字（葡萄牙語）另說明**：**「…API REST sem cadastro, downloads em Parquet e servidor MCP para consulta por IA.
